'''Claire''' (Japanese: '''クレア''' ''Claire'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[AG057|Going for a Spinda!]]''.

Claire lost her lucky {{p|Spinda}}, which had a special heart pattern on its face. Her butler [[Royce]], along with {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}}, decided to help locate it. However, the task proved to be difficult with {{TRT}}'s interventions and finding themselves surrounded by many different Spinda.

She was distraught throughout the whole search effort, though she was relieved to finally catch up with the Spinda and encounter [[Kain]], her fiancé and the lucky Spinda's owner. The trio were reunited in the place where they first met, a flower garden. After one more intervention by Team Rocket, the young lovers bid farewell to Ash and his friends.
